limitations: The compatibility projection restores only the old model input to the bank mean; it does not teach q6/qd6-conditioned motion.
Goal sensitivity is a property of this frozen pretrained checkpoint and its data, not repaired by input compatibility.
CPU inference checks numerical contracts only; no physical dynamics, collision, or deployment safety validation was performed.

runtime_input_policy.legacy_v1: No input projection; exactly the old normalization path.
runtime_input_policy.train_constant_compat_v1: Project only the four history q6 and four qd6 state features to checkpoint x_mean.
